newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil recovers.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil recovers.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday, with gas oil recovering from Thursday's big sell-off.
Gasoline was weaker as Thursday's NYMEX losses ensured that the transatlantic arbitrage was firmly shut.
Naphtha was also softer as swaps led the physical market notionally lower.
Gas oil prices recovered in line with IPE futures and diesel premiums rose sharply again on a continuing perception of scarcity.
Fuel oil edged higher with barges trading as high as $125 fob ARA and a high sulphur cargo done at $117 fob NWE.
